summary: NAFDAC relays a WHO alert on three DEG-contaminated oral liquid medicines found in India: COLDRIF, Respifresh TR and ReLife. Diethylene glycol can cause kidney injury and death, especially in children. NAFDAC zonal offices are to carry out surveillance and mop-up.
